title: add-jsonschema-response_format-and-strict-mode-with-validation-errors
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds first-class JSONSchema-based structured-output support to the API surface with a new response_format parameter, server-side validation, descriptive validation errors, and a strict mode that enforces schema-only output. Motivated by recurring support requests and recent eval regressions when downstream tooling expects stable canonical JSON output. This PR implements: 1) API contract: new response_format=json_schema and response_format.strict=true/false; 2) server JSONSchema validator with clear error codes and a user-facing error payload; 3) streaming compatibility: incremental validation checkpoints and graceful fallback to non-structured streaming when strict mode is off; 4) OpenAI-compat layer updates to accept function/tool calling combined with schema responses; 5) docs, SDK bindings, and integration tests. Backcompat: default behavior is unchanged (freeform text). When strict mode is enabled the model output is validated and failing responses cause a structured error to be returned to the client; for non-strict the validator attaches warnings in the response metadata and attempts best-effort repair heuristics. References: previous structured-output PRs pr-23347, pr-27521, pr-30780. Linear: ENG-1892. See release notes for toggles and migration guidance.

release_notes: Added response_format=json_schema with an optional strict mode to enforce validated JSON output; default behavior unchanged. See docs/api/structured-output.md for migration and examples. SDKs updated to surface response metadata and structured validation errors.
notes_on_backcompat: Defaults preserve current freeform text output. Clients must opt into response_format=json_schema to receive structured responses. Strict mode will reject non-compliant outputs; non-strict will provide metadata/warnings and best-effort repairs.
